title: Exactly on the limit
request: It is 2026-10-28 at 09:15 UTC. I need this used drill delivered for flatpack assembly. My hard limit is 1,000 SEK including every mandatory charge; exactly 1,000 SEK is acceptable. I cannot collect it and own suitable bits. Does the supplied offer fit? Use only the supplied evidence.

evidence.text: Synthetic listing; Northbank is fictional. D18 kit includes the drill, A18-2 battery and C18-A charger. Item price: 899.95 SEK. Seller says it works. No measured battery runtime is supplied.

Synthetic checkout quote for this buyer and this offer: delivery 49.95 SEK; mandatory buyer fee 50.10 SEK. No other mandatory charges apply. All prices are in SEK and this quote is valid through 2026-10-28T18:00:00Z.
Synthetic exact-model reference: D18 supports ordinary flatpack screw driving with the buyer's bits, accepts A18-2 batteries and uses C18-A charging.

hard_failures.text: Computes a total other than 1,000.00 SEK, treats this inclusive budget as exceeded, or claims the total is strictly below 1,000 SEK.
Claims that a complete price quote also verifies battery health or the listed unit's condition.

usefulness.text: Shows that 899.95 + 49.95 + 50.10 equals exactly 1,000.00 SEK and meets the explicitly inclusive budget with no headroom.
Separates the supported price conclusion from unresolved condition and avoids asking for a delivery quote already supplied.
Makes any future price recommendation conditional on the quote still applying at commitment time.

acceptable_outcomes: The supplied offer meets the price limit exactly, while the condition remains seller-reported.
Recommend pursuing condition checks and rechecking terms if commitment occurs after the quote expires.
